mechanism: Reversible componentwise A*x mod4 into two syndrome wires per component; measure syndrome and retain ALL original phase qubits
static_gate_bound: At most2*n*m CX/CCX gates, zero extra arithmetic work qubits, m+2n total wires
arbitrary_syndrome_action: (x,z)->(x,z+A*x) modulo4 componentwise; not general XOR into the syndrome
retained_block_representation: Implicit measured-fiber predicate on original Boolean basis; no compact fiber index or fiber inverse
falsifiers: Any gate-basis input changing x or disagreeing with componentwise modular addition
Any missing measurement outcome, uncharged postselection or probability-mass loss
Injective finite source whose Holevo falls below the proven entropy lower bound
Granting fresh product-state, inverse or compact-index access from a block record
remaining_obligations: Independent information-bound review and actual natural-source noise law
A useful scalable observable/transition on the implicit block
Matched classical dequantization checks and full secret decoder
Physical backend transpilation if hardware resource claims are needed
